data.description: 魅族推送服务是由魅族公司为开发者提供的消息推送服务，开发者可以向集成了魅族 push SDK 的客户端实时地推送通知或者消息，与用户保持互动，提高活跃率。
data.label: Meizu Push

data.description: Meizu Push Service is a message push service provided by Meizu for developers, allowing developers to push notifications or messages to clients integrated with the Meizu push SDK in real-time, keeping interaction with users and increasing activity rate.
data.label: Meizu Push
